$comment: Conformance suite for docs/architecture/CARD_TYPE_DETECTION.md. Any engine that auto-detects card shape — razbiram.com included — should pass every case. `card` is the input; `mode` is the required result; `typedPromotionSafe` is whether the runtime may re-present it as typed recall. Cases are deliberately minimal: only the fields detection reads are present, because detection must not depend on anything else.

cases.name: multiple-select is never typed-promoted even if a correctAnswer leaked in
cases.$comment: The format omits correctAnswer for this shape. If one ever appears, detection must still refuse promotion — typing one answer for a multi-answer card marks a correct learner wrong.

cases.name: two options alone do not make a true/false card
cases.$comment: Counting options answers a different question than the one being asked. A genuine single-answer question may have two options.

cases.name: several correct options alone do not make a multiple-select card
cases.$comment: Without the marker this is a malformed single-answer card, not a different shape. It must not be silently reinterpreted.

cases.name: a multiple-select card with one correct option is still multiple-select
cases.$comment: The learner must still be able to select more than one, and scoring is still all-or-nothing.

cases.name: both markers is invalid, not a coin flip
an unrecognised selectionMode is not multiple-select
an unrecognised type is unknown, never a default render
cases.$comment: New formats will be added again. Falling back to MCQ turns an unrecognised card into a plausible-looking wrong one.
